integrity: Mathematical proof reconstructs out-neighborhood twin classes, colored closed-walk formulas, and permanent pebble games. Standalone finite scripts corroborate selected instances and arithmetic, but do not substitute for proofs of unbounded statements. The assessment is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Pure directed-arc/equality language, nonempty independent clone fibers over one consistently oriented cycle of length at least three, counting-free finite-variable logic. No statement about more general digraphs, counting, formula-size optimality, or global definability outside this class. The novelty comparison is bounded and a more general substitution theorem may subsume this result.
title: Four low-width theories and necklace invariants for cyclic independent-fiber digraphs
